GF-T16: six trits

You will learn

How GF-T16 spends 6 exponent trits and 9 mantissa bits, and how many exponent values that gives.

GF-T16 has 1 sign, 6 exponent trits and 9 mantissa bits. Six trits give 3^6 = 729 exponent values; offset 364 balances them and offset 728 is not finite. The split in thousandths is 6000 / 9 = 666. Its mantissa has the same 9 bits as GF16, so the two differ only in how they store the exponent.

Try it

Run the two tests of gft16.t27. Then compare MANT_BITS with GF16 and work out the range 729 exponent values cover around zero.
